sources.publisher: Vocational Training Council (VTC) 香港職業訓練局
sources.evidence: HD 課程 typical study duration of two years；約 96% HD 畢業生升讀本地/海外全日制學士學位課程；逾 90% 獲政府資助或津貼；選擇專業生涯的 HD 畢業生平均就業率約 90%；升讀途徑為 THEi top-up degree 與 SHAPE 合辦課程

工程類 HD 完整清單（17 個 programme code：EG114101/114105/114111/114128/114142/114143/114401/114403/114405/114701/114702/114704/114705/114712/114728/114738/AS110114）含院校校區；~91% 專業就業率；Articulation 大學名單（THEi/HKU/CUHK/HKUST/PolyU/CityU/RMIT/Coventry/UCLan/UWE Bristol）；Professional Recognition 機構與政府部門清單；IA-IBSP 2023/24 約 1,000 名學生、230 家公司

「We offer flexible articulation pathways for Higher Diploma or Associate Degree graduates aspiring to pursue a Degree programme.」；THEi Senior Year Entry 收生點 Year 2/Year 3；2023 畢業生就業率逾 95%（2024 年 5 月）；WIL 實作訓練要求
SHAPE 與海外及內地大學合辦 top-up degree，畢業證書由夥伴大學頒發；英國及澳洲課程獲認可為 QF Level 5，equivalent to locally accredited Bachelor's Degree programmes；最快一年完成

Award Levels 層級含 Certificate；Certificate of Vocational Education (CVE) 課程清單（Electrical Engineering、Lift and Escalator、Electronic and Computer Engineering、Automotive Technology、Building Services Engineering 等），多數獲政府部門認可為牌照註冊的學歷要求

sources.publisher: The University of Hong Kong — HKU Admissions
sources.evidence: 專頁 HONG KONG SUB-DEGREES：「Every year, we set aside several senior-year places for current students or graduates of a full-time associate degree (AD) or two-year or higher diploma programme (HD) from a community college in Hong Kong.」；資格表（本地應屆/非應屆畢業生可申請 senior year，AD/HD 在讀者及已持學位者只可申請 first year）；Direct Admissions Scheme to Senior Year Places 逐學院課程代碼與名額（工程學院 A501/A503/A504/A506/A509/A512/A513 共 34 名額；理學院 75；社會科學學院 47；文學院 54；教育學院 40/20/20；護理 25）；Programme Specific Requirements（工程學院須 same or a related discipline）；日期：2026-09-23 開始申請、2026-11-25 首輪截止、2027-02/03 放榜、2027-09-01 開課

General Entrance Requirements：「An appropriate Higher Diploma / Associate Degree from a recognised institution」；「senior year and top-up degree places are intended for Associate Degree / Higher Diploma holders to articulate to a degree scheme / programme. Applicants with other qualifications will normally not be considered.」；非英文授課院校之 AD/HD 須符合英文要求

Credit Transfer and Exemption：「These students will follow a reduced curriculum of 60 to 75 credits, and further credit transfer will normally not be possible.」；另需符合 Undergraduate Degree Language and Communication Requirements (LCR) 等效標準；頁面列有 Senior Year Admission (SYA) Project 章節

ECTS 官方數字：60 ECTS credits = 一學年；short cycle qualification 通常 90–120 ECTS；first cycle 學士 180 或 240 ECTS；second cycle 碩士 90 或 120 ECTS；third cycle varies；1 QF credit = 10 notional learning hours（另見 HKQF）

HKQF 於 2008-05-05 正式啟動；為 seven-level hierarchy（官方明文為 7 級，非 8 級）；QF level 依 Generic Level Descriptors (GLD) 分配；QF credit 衡量學習量，One QF credit consists of 10 notional learning hours；Award Titles Scheme (ATS) 共有 15 個 award titles；Credit Accumulation and Transfer (CAT) 政策；頁面最後修訂日期 2024-07-07
因 www.hkqf.edu.hk TCP timeout、hkcaavq.edu.hk 反爬驗證，本頁透過 Google Translate 代理成功取得 HKQF The Framework 正文（證據同上）。後續 /en/qf-level 與 /en/qf-ats 兩頁因 Google 速率限制（CAPTCHA）未取得
